staticMote.reason: Jagged pale-steel filaments with amber/violet flecks read as static discharge, no halo, no text or faces. Slightly flat and clean-edged at 4x but crisp and legible at 80px, and clearly more readable than the shipped soft blob with two wing strokes. Watch that it does not read as a spider at small size; keep the flecks.

staticMoteLoop.reason: 8 frames with distinct filament angles and spark positions and a gentle core pulse; shimmers rather than rotates, no popping or seams, consistent silhouette and size across frames.

skitter.reason: Downscaled to 80px the streaks and curl still read as wind, the teal trail holds up. Still fine.
